records.name: OpenClaw AI
records.one_liner: Reusable model and streaming primitives extracted from the OpenClaw ecosystem, with isolated explicit provider registries and application-owned policy.

dims.loop: Inference/stream primitives, not a complete agent loop; caller controls tool execution and repeated requests.
dims.providers: Common model contracts and explicit isolated provider registry; importing does not globally register built-ins.
dims.tools: Tool-call model representation and streaming, while execution policy and actual host tools are application responsibilities.
dims.context: Common request/message representation; no product AGENTS.md loading, skills or context-engine policy included.
dims.state: No session persistence or recovery runtime in the inference layer.
dims.safety: Inert host-policy defaults and caller-controlled transport; no tool approval or OS sandbox runtime.
dims.extensibility: Provider registration and host/transport hooks; internal subpaths lack semver guarantees.
dims.multi_agent: No child-session or routed-agent orchestrator in this layer.
dims.surfaces: Directly importable public package; product gateway and private agent-core are separate.
dims.observability: Streaming events enable caller instrumentation; no turnkey product diagnostic service in this layer.

used_by: OpenClaw private agent-core and gateway product
key_insights: A useful reusable layer exists, but it is an inference library rather than the complete product harness.
Credential, catalogue, retry/failover and host-policy decisions remain with the application.

features_notes.hooks: Provider/transport/host hooks only, not full agent lifecycle hooks.
features_notes.plugins: Provider registration rather than the product plugin catalogue.

records.name: OpenClaw
records.one_liner: Gateway-centric personal-agent platform with replaceable harness and context engine, extensive channel/tool plugins and selective turn/delivery recovery.

dims.loop: Embedded agent-core loop plus gateway-owned attempt preparation, steering, tool scheduling, transcript custody and final delivery; plugins can replace the harness.
dims.providers: OpenClaw AI inference primitives plus product authentication, catalogue, retry/failover and route-specific native harness selection.
dims.tools: Coding, process, memory, channel, search and plugin tools; host versus sandbox implementations selected during construction; scoped authenticated loopback MCP server.
dims.context: Workspace AGENTS/SOUL/IDENTITY/USER/MEMORY conventions and skills; context-engine assembly, compaction, bootstrap and maintenance are replaceable plugin contracts.
dims.state: SQLite session/transcript storage, admitted-turn recovery custody and delivery recovery with caller reauthorization and narrow replay-safe-tool rules. Incognito state is intentionally ephemeral.
dims.safety: Optional Docker confinement with network/capability/security/resource controls; main-session tools execute on host by default. Child workspace restrictions propagate.
dims.extensibility: Public hooks, tools, channels, providers, context engines, compaction providers and complete alternate harness registration; private runtime packages are a different boundary.
dims.multi_agent: Configured routed identities, child sessions, worktree requests and native external harnesses, with inherited workspace and caller constraints.
dims.surfaces: Gateway WebSocket/HTTP, CLI, channels, Control UI, native clients, ACP and MCP; use plugins or gateway clients rather than treating private agent-core as a supported library.
dims.observability: Diagnostic/lifecycle hooks and optional diagnostics-otel service plugin; not proof all model content is traced by default.

builds_on: Incorporated Pi-derived code (third-party notices), not current pi-agent-core package
SQLite storage and optional Docker execution
used_by: First-party gateway, Control UI, CLI, native clients and channels
key_insights: At this pin Pi ancestry is incorporated-code lineage; the remaining direct Pi dependency is pi-tui.
Harness replacement and context replacement are independent public extension seams within the product.
Private @openclaw/agent-core and @openclaw/sdk exports do not establish independently supported public SDKs.

features_notes.in_process_sdk: Plugin embedding is supported; agent-core/gateway SDK workspace packages are private.
features_notes.os_sandbox: Optional Docker configuration; main-session host execution is the documented default.
features_notes.durable_resume: Selective authorized restart continuation and delivery recovery; not arbitrary effect replay.
features_notes.plan_mode: Not established in the reviewed source.

checked_claims: Pi notices and direct dependency graph
Restart recovery constraints and sandbox defaults
limitations: Static source and first-party documentation review only.
No runtime, gateway exposure, crash-injection or network-isolation tests.
Manifest version and latest release tag differ and are reported separately.
